info.title: Sonatype Nexus Repository
info.description:
Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager REST API provides programmatic management of repositories, components, and assets for artifact lifecycle management across package formats such as Maven, npm, Docker, NuGet, PyPI, and more.

Authentication: HTTP Basic — Nexus administrator username and password. Configure accounts under Security → Users in the Nexus admin UI.

Source: https://help.sonatype.com/en/rest-and-integration-api.html
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 146 of 241 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: repository management (create/read/update/delete across all supported repository formats and types), component and asset management (list, get, upload, delete, search). See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
